name: etsy-marketplaces-mcp
description: Etsy (marketplaces): me, list_products, get_product, create_product, list_sales. Every tool maps to

platform_mcp_etsy_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ETSY_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_etsy_client_id.description: Etsy App API Key keystring (etsy.com/developers/your-apps); sent as client_id in the refresh grant form body (Etsy's refresh grant takes no client secret).

platform_mcp_etsy_api_key.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ETSY_API_KEY
platform_mcp_etsy_api_key.description: Value of the x-api-key header required on every v3 request: the keystring and the shared secret joined by a colon, e.g. 1aa2bb33c44d55eeeeee6fff:a1b2c3d4e5 (both on the Your Apps page).

platform_mcp_etsy_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ETSY_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_etsy_refresh_token.description: Refresh token (numeric user id prefix, e.g. 12345678.JNGI...) from a one-time OAuth 2.0 authorization-code + PKCE consent at etsy.com/oauth/connect with scopes shops_r listings_r listings_w transactions_r; valid 90 days, after which the seller consents again. Access tokens (1 h) are minted from it. A refresh grant also returns a new refresh token, which replaces the old one. The runtime keeps a rotated refresh token in memory; set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR to also save it (<dir>/<platform>.json, mode 0600) so it is preferred over this variable on the next start. The state file is keyed by platform id, so it is shared with ecommerce_channels/etsy: give each server its own PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR (or its own consent) so they never race on one rotating refresh token.

platform_mcp_etsy_shop_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ETSY_SHOP_ID
platform_mcp_etsy_shop_id.description: Numeric Etsy shop id (GET /v3/application/users/me returns it as shop_id).

platform_mcp_etsy_taxonomy_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ETSY_TAXONOMY_ID
platform_mcp_etsy_taxonomy_id.description: Seller taxonomy id every created listing is filed under (GET /v3/application/seller-taxonomy/nodes); required by create_product.

platform_mcp_etsy_who_made.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ETSY_WHO_MADE
platform_mcp_etsy_who_made.description: createDraftListing who_made for new listings: i_did | someone_else | collective; required by create_product.

platform_mcp_etsy_when_made.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ETSY_WHEN_MADE
platform_mcp_etsy_when_made.description: createDraftListing when_made for new listings, e.g. made_to_order, 2020_2026, 2010_2019, before_2007; required by create_product.

platform_mcp_etsy_shipping_profile_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ETSY_SHIPPING_PROFILE_ID
platform_mcp_etsy_shipping_profile_id.description: Shipping profile id for new physical listings (GET /v3/application/shops/{shop_id}/shipping-profiles); required for physical listings.

platform_mcp_etsy_readiness_state_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ETSY_READINESS_STATE_ID
platform_mcp_etsy_readiness_state_id.description: Processing profile id for new physical listings (GET /v3/application/shops/{shop_id}/readiness-state-definitions); required for physical listings.

platform_mcp_etsy_return_policy_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_ETSY_RETURN_POLICY_ID
platform_mcp_etsy_return_policy_id.description: Optional return policy id for new listings (GET /v3/application/shops/{shop_id}/policies/return).

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /v3/application/users/me (scope shops_r) returns {user_id, shop_id} for the seller who granted the token.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: GET /v3/application/shops/{shop_id}/listings?state (active|inactive|sold_out|draft|expired; Etsy defaults to active)&limit(1-100)&offset (scope listings_r). `price` is price.amount in MINOR units - divide by price.divisor (usually 100): 1999 = 19.99 in price.currency_code. created_at / updated_at are epoch seconds.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: GET /v3/application/listings/{listing_id}; `price` is in minor units (see list_products).

tools.name: create_product
tools.description: Creates a DRAFT listing (not published) with createDraftListing (form-encoded, scope listings_w): title = name, description (REQUIRED by Etsy - always pass it), price in the shop's currency as a decimal (e.g. 19.99; `currency` is ignored because the shop currency applies), quantity fixed at 1, type physical, and who_made / when_made / taxonomy_id / shipping_profile_id / readiness_state_id / return_policy_id from config. `url` is ignored. Publishing needs an image upload (multipart, not mapped) and then state=active.

tools.name: list_sales
tools.description: GET /v3/application/shops/{shop_id}/transactions?limit&offset (scope transactions_r): one row per sold listing line (transaction_id, receipt_id, listing_id, title, quantity, price {amount, divisor, currency_code} per unit in MINOR units, buyer_user_id, created_timestamp epoch seconds). The endpoint has no date or listing filter, so `since` and `product_id` are not sent; buyer emails are not exposed.
